Name: Overgrown Flowery Interface - Font Settings
Author: symphonicoptimism
Description:
This is a recolor of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Becks723's Font Settings[/url] graphical assets that harmonizes with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]SugarSugarRuin's Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]. It also harmonizes with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12873]RoseDryad's recolor of the Mod Update Menu[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12376]Rustyasahalo's recolor of the Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[u][b]To install:[/b][/u][list]
[*]Unzip the mod file to locate the [i]overgrown flowery interface - font settings[/i] directory, which contains 11 .png files.
[*]Copy these .png files to the [i]assets[/i] directory of the Font Settings mod within your Stardew Valley mods directory.
[/list][b][u]With gratitude to:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Becks723 for permission to recolor the Font Settings assets.
[*]SugarSugarRuin for the beautiful Overgrown Flowery Interface.
[*]RoseDryad and Rustyasahalo for the recolors that inspired this one.
[*]The Stardew Modmaker Community for their warmth and encouragement.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Initial upload. Zip file includes one directory with 11 .png images that replace the original graphics in Font Settings assets.
